title: Senior Software Engineer - ZTC
locationText: In-Office | Austin, TX | Lisbon, Portugal | London, United Kingdom

description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Lisbon, London, Austin
About the team
The Zero Trust Connectivity team builds the hub that connects Cloudflare One and Zero Trust products such as Cloudflare WAN, Cloudflare One Client, Cloudflare Tunnels, Gateway and Workers VPC. Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.
As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.
We are a team of engineers who obsess over building reliable services which leverage Cloudflare's unique architecture and global network footprint.
You can read more about what we work on here:
• https://blog.cloudflare.com/introducing-cloudflare-one/
• https://blog.cloudflare.com/from-ip-packets-to-http-the-many-faces-of-our-oxy-framework/
• https://blog.cloudflare.com/workers-vpc-open-beta/
About the role
As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. Our technology stack includes Rust, Linux networking, Clickhouse, SaltStack, Prometheus, AI harnesses, and our own Cloudflare Workers platform. We're looking for determined, curious, empathetic engineers to join our team!
Desirable skills, knowledge, and experience
• Programming experience in Rust
• Familiar with Layer 3 and Layer 4 Networking
• Systems-level programming experience in Linux
• Experience building large-scale, reliable, highly distributed systems
• Attention to detail and ability to solve complex customer problems
• Own solutions end-to-end and driving the design, development, and deployment process
• Able to work across teams and level common, sustainable solutions
• Creative, open-minded, collaborative problem solver
• Focus on clarity in written and verbal communication
• Leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
• For Lisbon based hires: Estimated annual salary of €66,000-83,000
Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

About us:
We believe the next generation of financial services will be powered by stablecoins.
Founded in 2021, our mission at BVNK is to accelerate global money movement.
We’re building stablecoin-native infrastructure so businesses can move value instantly across borders and networks. With global licenses and T1 bank partnerships, we facilitate billions in transactions for enterprise clients like Worldpay, Deel, LianLian Global, and Rapyd.
Our technology is transforming how businesses operate globally by eliminating payment delays, reducing costs, and unlocking trapped capital.
We’re a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.
In 2025, we secured strategic investment from Visa, following our $50 million Series B with Haun Ventures, Coinbase Ventures, Scribble Ventures, DRW Venture Capital, Avenir, and Tiger Global. With the backing of these leading investors, we’re accelerating our growth – and we're looking for smart, ambitious people to help us build the future of financial services.
We're incredibly honored to have made Newsweek's list of The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces three years running (most recently in 2025) and to have been recognised by LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK in 2024.
Location: We offer a Hybrid/Remote working policy.
About this role in the team:
We’re looking for a talented Tech Lead to lead the technical direction and delivery of the Billing & Fees subdomain within BVNK’s Ledger domain.
Billing & Fees sits at the heart of how BVNK monetises its products and services. The team is responsible for ensuring that every transaction is billed accurately, fees are applied correctly, and invoices can be generated, reconciled and audited with confidence.
Today, several of these processes rely on manual workflows and spreadsheets. As BVNK scales, we're building the automated infrastructure needed to support increasingly complex commercial agreements, growing transaction volumes, and enterprise-grade financial operations.
As Tech Lead, you'll be responsible for shaping the architecture and technical roadmap of our billing platform, turning complex financial and commercial requirements into reliable, scalable engineering solutions.
You'll lead the design and development of services supporting fee configuration, fee calculation, invoicing, billing automation and reconciliation, ensuring that the systems we build are accurate, resilient and maintainable.

• Own the technical direction of Billing & Fees: Define and drive the architecture, technical strategy and engineering roadmap for billing services, ensuring solutions support BVNK's evolving commercial models, transaction volumes and operational requirements.
• Lead the development of scalable billing infrastructure: Architect and build services responsible for fee policy configuration, fee calculation, invoice generation, billing adjustments and reconciliation, replacing manual processes with automated, reliable workflows.
• Drive end-to-end billing automation: Design robust data pipelines and integrations connecting systems such as Snowflake, Salesforce, Ledger and internal financial services, ensuring accurate data flows from transaction processing through to invoicing and reporting.
• Ensure financial accuracy and auditability: Establish engineering patterns that support financial correctness, including idempotency, traceability, reconciliation, exception handling and comprehensive audit trails. Ensure billing discrepancies can be identified, investigated and resolved effectively.

THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role you’ll own complex improvements to it end to end, from defining the problem and designing the solution through evaluation, rollout and learning from production.

Your work will span agent capabilities and tools, knowledge retrieval, answer quality and infrastructure, with real trade-offs between model quality, latency, reliability and cost. This is a hands-on product engineering role, not a research-only or prompt-only position. You’ll also help other product teams build AI features well by sharing patterns, pairing with them and improving the reusable foundations they rely on.

 - Evaluation you can trust. Build evaluation loops with representative datasets, experiments, regression checks and, where useful, automated judges calibrated against human judgment.

 - Root-cause fixes in production. Diagnose failures across prompts, retrieval, tools, models and infrastructure, fix the underlying cause and verify the fix with evidence.

 - Explicit trade-offs. Choose models and system designs deliberately, and document decisions and rollout criteria.

 - AI capability across teams. Support other product teams through technical guidance, code review, pairing and mentoring, so they can deliver AI features independently.


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - Senior-level engineering judgment and a track record of independently leading complex production work from design through operation and improvement.

 - Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered product capabilities to production, with clear personal responsibility for implementation and delivery decisions.

 - Real depth in at least some of the following: retrieval/RAG and indexing, evaluation datasets and experiments, LLM-as-judge, or agents and tool calling.

 - The ability to tell model, retrieval, tooling and application failures apart, and to validate improvements with evidence.

 - Strong fundamentals in coding, debugging, testing, API integration and system design, plus willingness to work in Ruby/Rails and React.

 - Sound judgment about sensitive data, access control, model limitations and operational risk.

 - Clear communication of trade-offs, effective async collaboration with product and engineering partners, and practical mentoring.

Nice to have

 - Production experience with Ruby on Rails, especially integrating AI capabilities into an established backend.

 - Full-stack delivery of conversational or assistant experiences.

 - Slack or in-app assistant integrations with clear user and permission context.

 - Operating retrieval pipelines, agent tools, evaluation infrastructure, or model routing and cost controls at production scale.

 - Helping multiple teams adopt reusable AI patterns while balancing shared foundations against local needs.


WHY JOIN US

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.
Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.
• Taking ownership and driving impact
• Being open to change and feedback
• Being passionate about our mission and our customers.

Customer service is an area where Catawiki needs to do better. Feedback in app and Trustpilot reviews highlights frustration with the support experience. As Engineering Manager for CS Tech, you'll lead a cross-functional team with a clear mission: help buyers and sellers get the responses they need while reducing the cost of handling customer contacts. AI will be central to how you achieve both.
You'll build an empowered engineering team and shape the technical foundations for better, more cost-effective customer support. • Cross-functional collaboration : You've worked in product teams, partnering effectively with Product, UX, and business stakeholders.
• Technical judgement : You're confident guiding architectural trade-offs and decisions about complex systems.
• End-to-end ownership : You tackle problems through to resolution and move solutions forward through ambiguity.

description:

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Austin, TX | Lisbon, Portugal | London, UK
About the role
The Snr Software Engineer, AI & Infrastructure Planning role helps Cloudflare build, deploy, and operate one of the world's largest distributed networks. You will build an auditable multi-agent system on Cloudflare’s platform to replace notebooks and email threads with agent-driven forecasts, supply plans, cost models, and workflow approvals into agent workflows that planners & executives rely on for decision analysis.
Responsibilities
• Collaborate closely with capacity planning, networking, and data center engineering teams to encode technical domain expertise into structured specifications, formal data contracts, and agent functional capabilities.
• Architect, deploy, and maintain scalable production agents and durable workflows leveraging the Cloudflare Workers ecosystem, including Durable Objects, Workflows, D1, R2, Queues, Vectorize, Workers AI, and AI Gateway.
• Translate core infrastructure planning functions—such as forecasting, supply planning, cost modeling, narrative documentation, and executive approvals—into automated LLM deployment or deterministic logic based agent workflows designed for critical decision-making analysis.
• Implement rigorous risk tiering, formal approval checkpoints, detailed audit logs, and execution lineage to ensure safe autonomous operations.
• Incorporate predictive statistical and machine learning models into agent systems, establishing robust BigQuery data pipelines, optimized access patterns, and continuous monitoring.
• Author comprehensive technical specifications and Requests for Comments (RFCs), perform peer design reviews, and establish architectural standards for AI agent deployment across the organization.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
• Senior-level software engineering experience, with security conscious production systems you can point to (repos, releases, services you operated).
• Strong TypeScript, and comfort building on serverless or edge runtimes (Cloudflare Workers preferred). HTTP APIs, async, queues, performance.
• Experience with LLMs and agents: tool calling, structured output, multi-step or multi-agent orchestration, prompt and eval iteration.
• Experience with durable state and workflows (Durable Objects, Cloudflare Workflows, or equivalents such as Templets updraoral or Step Functions).
• Demonstrated experience in infrastructure planning: capacity planning, forecasting, networking, CDN, cloud or data center capacity, or adjacent work. We will teach you our specific systems.
• Solid data skills: SQL, a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred), and working knowledge of forecasting and statistical modeling (backtesting, error metrics, knowing when a model is wrong).
• Clear written communication: specs, RFCs, and explanations that planners and executives can use.
Bonus Points
• A data science or ML background (time series, optimization, predictive modeling) and Python for scientific computing.
• Experience with Hono, Zod, OpenAPI, and a modern frontend framework (Astro or React).

BENEFITS

title: Senior Developer Relations, Twitter Brand Rep
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all deeply integrated.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Developers decide what to build with by listening to people they trust, much of it on Twitter, where Supabase's community, launches, and competitors are all discussed in public. We want a senior DevRel leader who is already a known, trusted voice there, to be a brand ambassador for Supabase. You'll work alongside our New Media and DevRel teams and help shape how Supabase shows up in these conversations. We hire for the voice and following you already have.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be a visible, trusted voice for Supabase on Twitter: post, reply, and join developer conversations daily.

 - Share sharp, useful content, from launches and tips to opinions on where building is going.

 - Represent Supabase at events, on podcasts, and in the wider developer community.

 - Bring developer feedback to engineering and product, and work with New Media, DevRel, and PMM on launches.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF

 - You have an existing, engaged Twitter following. We'll look at who you talk to and how people respond, as well as follower count.

 - You have senior experience in DevRel, developer advocacy, or a similar developer-facing role.

 - You're credible with a technical audience and a strong writer with a distinctive voice.

 - You're comfortable representing a company publicly, on camera, on stage, and online.

 - High agency and self-directed.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Fully Remote
   
   We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

 - ESOP
   
   Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

 - Tech Allowance
   
   Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

 - Health Benefits
   
   Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

 - Annual Off-Sites
   
   Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

 - Flexible Work
   
   We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

 - Professional Development
   
   Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
   
   


ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

 - ~400 team members

 - 60+ countries

 - 20+ languages spoken

 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

 - 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Senior Software Engineer [Portugal]
description:
About Grupo QuintoAndar
Grupo QuintoAndar is the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America, with brands and solutions across six countries.
Our purpose is to help people love where they live by making the housing journey simpler, from finding a home to managing life in it.
We’re also investing R$ 2 billion in technology and AI over the next two years, expanding our engineering capabilities and developing more conversational product experiences. To learn more about our story, visit: https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/ .
Location & Remote Work
Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo office. Furthermore, we offer the Work From Anywhere program, allowing you to work from any country for up to 90 days a year, ensuring you have the flexibility to do the best work of your career.
The Role
As a Staff Software Engineer, you will be a core driver of our technical execution. Here, you won't just "maintain old systems" or "take tickets." We are an organization of builders guided by deep technical density. You will use our Leadership Principles, like Dive Deep and Make it Great, to solve high-impact distribution problems and build the systems of our next decade.
We believe that technology scales execution, but senior talent scales judgment. You will be at the forefront of our AI-First pivot, designing highly scalable, resilient systems capable of supporting low-latency conversational journeys, heavy microservices orchestration, and real-time ML processing.
Our Tech Stack: We work with Java, Kotlin, Node.js, Go, Python, React, and more, primarily hosted on AWS. Our daily workflow also incorporates various AI tools, including Claude Code.
Don't worry if you haven't mastered our exact stack. We value strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and an engineering mindset over specific technology experience.
Position & Technical Challenges:
We hire Staff Software Engineers through a unified selection process for multiple engineering teams.
At the final stage, you'll have the opportunity to explore which team best matches your experience and interests, alongside our hiring needs.
What we are looking for:
• 10+ years of experience in software development, leading the delivery of high-volume, high-concurrency, and mission-critical distributed systems.
• Deep knowledge of modern software architecture paradigms, distributed data consistency, fault tolerance, and system optimization.
• Understanding of data-intensive applications and readiness to build architectures that support Machine Learning/AI features at scale.
• Proven ability to analyze and articulate engineering trade-offs concretely (e.g., simplicity vs. flexibility, velocity vs. reliability, build vs. buy).
• Demonstrated capability to remove barriers to collaboration, conduct difficult structural conversations, and foster an inclusive engineering culture.
• Fluency in Portuguese and excellent English skills (mandatory).
You'll stand out if you:
• Have prior experience designing architectures that natively integrate with LLMs, multi-agent AI systems, or heavy data pipelines.
• Have a strong background in FinOps and cost-optimization for high-throughput cloud environments.
• Have solid experience migrating legacy monolithic structures into highly decoupled, event-driven architectures.
Important
• Our hiring process starts with the application! If you truly want to be part of our team, please complete this step of the process. We analyze all candidates individually and provide feedback to all applicants.
• All communication will be conducted via email, so please stay tuned for our messages and release the domain @quintoandar.com.br to ensure our emails are not sent to spam.
Hiring Process Stages
The stages of our hiring processes aim to assess your experiences and allow you to meet our teams and explore career opportunities. They are structured as follows:
• Application
• Technical CV screening
• People Interview with Recruiters
• Tech Screening with Engineering Team (code live case)
• Technicals Interviews (architecture live cases and tech leadership)
• Offer
Benefits
• Competitive salary
• Profit sharing
• Meal allowance
• Health insurance
• Dental plan
• Life insurance
• Childcare subsidy and Atypical Parenthood subsidy
• Wellhub
• Home office allowance
• Employee assistance program (mental health, social, legal, and financial support)
• Extended parental leave
• Day off on birthday, Mother’s Day, and Father’s Day
• Benefits Club (discounts on everyday services)
• Discounts at educational institutions
• Reading kit for children – PlayKids
Diversity & Inclusion at Grupo QuintoAndar
We value diversity and want everyone to feel welcome here, regardless of their age, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, ethnicity, origin, disability, religion, or any other characteristic. All our job openings are open to all individuals!
You'll notice there are some diversity questions in the application form. For affirmative action roles, this information may be used to verify your alignment with the target audience for the opportunity. In such cases, it may be used for elimination purposes. For non-affirmative action roles, this data will be used anonymously, exclusively to monitor and improve our inclusion practices in the hiring process, and will have no impact on your application.
Privacy and Data Protection
The Grupo QuintoAndar operates in compliance with privacy and data protection laws, including, but not limited to, the Brazilian General Personal Data Protection Law (LGPD) (Law No. 13,709/2018), and ensures the security of your data. To learn more, please access our Privacy Notice for Candidates . For questions or to exercise your rights as a data subject, please contact us through our Service Channel .

description:
Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values -driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.
The opportunity
At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
We are proud of:
• The work we do and the innovation we drive
• Our values of share, care a nd dare
• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration
The role
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect – CoreMedia to join our team and work on a strategic digital commerce programmes for brands within the LVMH Group.
You will play a key role at the intersection of technology, architecture, e-commerce and digital experience, owning the target architecture of the CoreMedia platform and guiding the successful delivery of complex digital projects.
You will act as the architecture reference for the delivery teams, defining robust and scalable solutions, setting technical standards and supporting Tech Leads and Senior Developers in applying them.
The role can be based nearshore (Portugal) , in which case onsite presence with the client in Paris La Défense is required for a minimum of three consecutive days every month , or in France , in which case onsite presence with the client in Paris La Défense is more required every week .

• Define and own the target architecture and solution design of CoreMedia Content Cloud solutions (Studio, CAE, Headless Server, Content Delivery APIs), ensuring scalability, performance, security and maintainability.

• Govern technical debt, CoreMedia upgrades and Blueprint evolution, and anticipate architectural risks and dependencies.
• Coach and mentor Tech Leads and developers, promote knowledge sharing and architecture best practices, and foster technical autonomy and continuous improvement.
• Work in an Agile (Scrum / SAFe) setup: contribute to ceremonies and, in a SAFe environment, to PI Planning and the identification of architectural and technical dependencies across teams.
• Ensure clear reporting and visibility on architecture decisions, technical progress, risks and quality, using Jira and Confluence.
Must have qualifications
To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:
• 8+ years of experience in Java/JEE development, including 3+ years at least on CoreMedia (Content Cloud / CMS, Studio, CAE, Headless Server, Blueprint).
• Strong expertise in Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Maven , Freemarker/JSP templating and JavaScript / TypeScript .
• Solid experience designing REST and GraphQL APIs and headless / hybrid CMS architectures, including target-state definition and technology choices.
• Proven experience as Solution Architect or Technical Architect (or Lead Developer with architecture ownership): technical decision-making, architecture governance, design reviews and mentoring.
• Experience designing the integration of a CMS with e-commerce platforms, PIM, DAM and search solutions in a complex enterprise landscape.
• Good knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker/Kubernetes and a cloud provider (AWS, Azure or GCP), including cloud-native architecture patterns.
• Good understanding of performance, caching, security, SEO and accessibility for large-scale web platforms, and ability to define non-functional requirements.
• Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, SAFe) with Jira and Confluence .
• Strong communication skills and ability to work with technical teams, business stakeholders and clients , in onsite and distributed setups.
• Fluent English (C2).

title: Engineering Manager (Java/Kotlin Stack)
description:
Engineering Manager
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a team of backend engineers building the systems behind our financial products. You will own the team's delivery, technical direction and people growth, and help shape engineering culture across the department. You'll operate with significant autonomy, making key decisions on architecture, priorities and ways of working, and you will work closely with product and neighboring engineering teams to turn business goals into reliable, scalable services. Your work will directly impact the quality and speed with which Plata delivers to its customers.
Challenges that await you:
• Lead, mentor and grow a team of engineers: hiring, onboarding, career development and honest feedback, while fostering a culture of ownership and engineering excellence.
• Take ownership of your team's delivery and the reliability of its services: set priorities, plan roadmaps, and keep quality, scope and timelines in balance.
• Drive technical strategy and architecture for high-load, distributed systems, balancing immediate business needs with long-term, future-proof decisions.
• Partner with product, other engineering teams and stakeholders to understand needs, align on priorities and provide a seamless, dependable service.
